autoCompleteNotReady: Available once a foundation builds past its ace

tutorial.foundation: Four foundations sit between the wings, pre-seeded with the four Aces. Build each pile by suit from Ace to King.
tutorial.tableau: Two wings of four columns flank the foundations — eight columns of six face-up cards. Only the rightmost card of each column is playable.
tutorial.moves: Move single cards onto any card one rank lower (suit doesn't matter). Empty columns accept any card.
tutorial.controls: Use hint, undo, and auto-complete buttons.

hintReason.toFoundation: Send this card to the foundation to free up the column.
hintReason.toTableau: Apply the suggested tableau move to unlock buried cards.
